annotations.text: A branching episode: two lines of development fork from the start state and converge at the same conclusion (R). The derivation-DAG lens draws the fork and the merge; the storyboard / time-stack lenses (which assume a single line) are not offered for it.
Erasure order is immaterial — erase (P) then (Q), or (Q) then (P); both reach (R). The episode exists to exercise branch structure, not to assert a new theorem (low warrant, authored here).
